The pizza slice, folded or overlapping, is about 220 px by 100 px, which is roughly 14 cm by 6.5 cm. It is thin, about 1 cm. That gives roughly 90 cm³, and with a density of about 0.6 that comes to around 70 g. A thin cheese slice of this size is plausibly 80 g, so I'll use 80 g.

The greens look like roasted or fried broccoli rabe, covering about 170 px by 150 px. They are fairly loose and low, so I'll estimate about 45 g.

There may be a little oil on the greens, but it isn't clearly visible, so I won't list it separately.
